public.hero.intro: Mecropolis bɛ suman ka bonya tilew (GDD) lajɛ ka bɔ Open-Meteo funteni sɛbɛnnen na kabini dɔli. Western Cape suman waati bɛ taa yɔrɔ nata la ni jate bɔra suman ka dantigɛ kan.

public.how.title: Ka bɔ dɔli tile la ka taa bonya yɔrɔ la
public.how.lead: Bonya yɔrɔ bɛ don bolo la tuma caman, wa a bɛ kura fo kurayali laban. Yan, a bɛ jateminɛ waati sɛbɛnnen na, wa yɛlɛma bɛɛ daliluw bɛ mara.
public.step.1.title: Hadamaden ka dɔnni sɛbɛn
public.step.1.body: Foro yɔrɔw, forow, sumanw ani dɔli tilew bɛ mara Sanity la.
public.step.2.title: Waati kɛlen kunnafoni ta
public.step.2.body: Foro yɔrɔ ka tile o tile funteni bɛ bɔ Open-Meteo sɛbɛn kɔrɔw la, kabini dɔli fo bi.
public.step.3.title: Bonya tilew lajɛ
public.step.3.body: Suman ka bonya tilew (GDD) bɛ lajɛ suman jateminɛ sariyaw fɛ. Ni a bɔra dantigɛ kan, labɛnnikɛla bɛ suman waati taa yɔrɔ nata la, ka a dalilu sɛbɛn.
public.models.title: Suman jateminɛ sariyaw minnu bɛ kɛ
public.models.lead: Bonya tile minnu ka kan sani suman ka mɔgɔya dafa. Nin sariyaw sɛbɛnna bolo la, dalilu sɛbɛn si tɛ u la fɔlɔ.
public.live.title: Swartland lajɛli foro ka waati ko
public.live.lead: Kunnafoni bɛ bɔ foroba yɔrɔw la, a bɛ kura miniti 30 o miniti 30.
public.yields.title: Suman bɔli hakɛ jateminɛ sɛbɛnnenw
public.honesty.title: Kunnafoniw bɛ labɛn cogo min
public.honesty.1.title: Baarakɛla bɛ suman bɔli hakɛ don
public.honesty.1.body: Fɔlɔ, baarakɛla ma suman sɔrɔli sɛbɛn, porogaramu bɛ “Ma sɛbɛn” jira.
public.honesty.2.title: Farati hakɛw ye sɛbɛn wɛrɛw ye
public.honesty.2.body: Mara ni jamana kunnafoniw bɛ mara u yɛrɛ sɛbɛnw kɔnɔ, u bɔyɔrɔ ni u hakɛta ni. U tɛ suma ni foro suman sɔrɔli ye.
public.honesty.3.title: Nɔgɔnw kunnafoni ye mara ta ye
public.honesty.3.body: GBIF sɛbɛnw bɛ nɔgɔn ye yɔrɔ min na, o bɛ jira fo 100 km, ni jan caya ye.
public.honesty.4.title: Waati kunnafoni kura don
public.honesty.4.body: Funteni hakɛw bɛ ta Open-Meteo mara sɛbɛn kɔnɔ i n'a fɔ u ɲinini waati la.
public.open.title: Sɛnɛ san dɔ dayɛlɛ
public.open.body: Don demo kunnafoni yɔrɔ la ka sɛnɛ san GDD kurubu ni dalilu minnu bɛ a tigɛcogo jira.

public.live.weatherChart: Tile o tile funteni dɔgɔman ni belebele, ani sanji, waati nata kɔnɔ
public.live.pestsLead: Yɔrɔ sɛbɛnnenw minnu bɛ fo {radius} km foro lamini na.
public.yield.lead: Kurubu saba inw bɛ fɛn wɛrɛw suma yɔrɔ hakɛ wɛrɛw la. U tɛ se ka suma ɲɔgɔn na, wala foro si la.
public.about.title: A ko
public.about.heading: Mecropolis ko
public.about.lead: Mecropolis ye foro ni suman sɛbɛn porogaramu ye, Western Cape foro dɔ kama.
public.about.why.title: A sababu
public.about.why.body: Suman tigɛcogo sɛbɛnw bɛ kɔrɔ, suman sɔrɔli fana bɛ sɛbɛn hakilina fɛ. Mecropolis bɛ tigɛcogo jate waati sɛbɛnnen fɛ. Hakɛ bɛɛ bɛ bɔ baarakɛla dɔ wala kunnafoni bɔyɔrɔ tɔgɔlaman dɔ la.
public.about.design.title: A dilancogo
public.about.design.1.body: Funteni hakɛw (GDD) bɛ fara ɲɔgɔn kan kabini sɛnɛ tile, ka Open-Meteo mara sɛbɛn kɛ. Tigɛcogo bɛɛ yɛlɛma bɛ mara ni a daliluw ye: a daminɛ tile, GDD bɛɛ lajɛlen ni a jate bɔra min na.
public.about.design.2.body: Tigɛcogo min bɛ na suman tigɛ fɔlɔ kɔ, o tɔgɔ ye funteni fɛ mɔli ye, katuguni suman tigɛli ma sɛbɛn.
public.about.design.4.body: U bɛ mara u yɛrɛ sɛbɛnw kɔnɔ, ni bɔyɔrɔ, hakɛta ni yamaruya ye.
public.about.stack.title: Porogaramu minnu bɛ kɛ
public.about.stack.body: Vite ni React 19 porogaramu kelen bɛ Cloudflare Pages kan. Navigatɛri bɛ Sanity kunnafoni bɛɛ lajɛlen kalan a yɛrɛma ni GROQ ye, ani a bɛ yɛlɛmaw sɔrɔ o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ. Sɛbɛn donni ni kunnafoni lakodonen bɛ tɛmɛ Cloudflare Pages Functions fɛ; olu bɛ sesiyɔn kuki bolomata lajɛ. Zod bɛ kunnafoni donni ni bɔli lajɛ, Vitest bɛ porogaramu kɔrɔbɔ, Tailwind 4 bɛ a ɲɛcogo dilan.
public.about.limits.title: Dantigɛ minnu dɔnnen don
public.about.limits.1: Suman jateminɛ hakɛw (funteni daminɛ, funteni waati fo a bɔli ni a mɔli) sɛbɛnna bolo la, u dalilu bɔyɔrɔ tɛ yen fɔlɔ.
public.about.limits.2: Lupin farati hakɛ bɔra HarvestStat la, 2000 fo 2007 dɔrɔn. Kunnafoni daminɛli ma lupin farati sɛbɛn si sɔrɔ.
public.about.limits.3: Nɔgɔn kunnafoniw ye GBIF sɛbɛnw ye minnu bɛ foro lamini na. U bɛ jira sugu dɔ tun sɛbɛnna yɔrɔ min na foro kɛrɛfɛ.
public.about.limits.4: Demo bɛ don tɔgɔ kelen di bɛɛ ma, ani a bɛ ɲinini hakɛ dantigɛ hakili kɔnɔ. Donni bɛ kunnafoni yɔrɔw dogo, nka a tɛ kunnafoniw lakana: bɛɛ bɛ se ka kunnafoniw kalan. Nka a bɛ sɛbɛn donni bɛɛ lakana.

docs.stages.title: Tigɛcogo porogaramu
docs.stages.intro: Sɛnɛ san bɛ taa ɲɛ tigɛcogo wɔɔrɔ fɛ:
docs.stages.guards: Tɛmɛli kelen kelen bɛ a sariya sɔrɔ. Sɛnɛnen bɛ sɛnɛ tile ni suman ɲini; bɔli bɛ funteni tile hakɛ min bɛ a bɔ ɲini; suman tigɛ fɔlɔ bɛ mɔli hakɛ 90% ɲini; funteni fɛ mɔli bɛ mɔli hakɛ sɔrɔli ɲini; lajɛli bɛ sɛnɛ san waati ja ni farati hakɛ latigɛlen ɲini. GDD sariyaw fana bɛ funteni kunnafoni ɲini waati 90% la walasa, ani tɛmɛli bɛ bali ni a daminɛ tile bɛ sini.

docs.seed.title: Dɔnni daminɛ
docs.seed.body: {0} bɛ misali foroba, forow, sumanw ani sanni waatiw sɛbɛn kunnafoni marayɔrɔ sugandilen kɔnɔ, ka mara yɔrɔ hakɛw bɛn. A bɛ foroba, forow ani sumanw falen, o la i ka a kɛ kunnafoni marayɔrɔ dɔrɔn na min ye i ta ye.
guide.title: Mecropolis baaracogo
guide.lead: Gafe surun, kumakan nɔgɔman na. A bɛ app in nafama, a baarakɛlaw ani a yɔrɔ bɛɛ ka baara ɲɛfɔ.
guide.what.title: Mecropolis ye mun ye
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis ye forow ni sumanw lajɛlan ye. A bɛ suman bɛɛ ka yiriwali hakɛ jate, ka bɔ a dɔnni ma, ni tile kalaya ye min sɔrɔ. A bɛ waati, dugukolo ani kɔnɔmɔgɔw jira yɔrɔ kelen na.
guide.what.p2: A dilanna Afiriki Tilebinfan Cape forobaw de kama, nka a bɛ se ka baara foroba bɛɛ, mara bɛɛ ani sanni waati bɛɛ la.
guide.who.title: A dilanna minnu kama
guide.who.p1: A ye forow kɔlɔsila ta ye, i n'a fɔ sɛnɛkɛla, foroba ɲɛmɔgɔ walima ladilikan dila.
guide.who.p2: I mako tɛ ordinatɛri walima waati dɔnni na. Ni i bɛ se ka siti dɔ dayɛlɛ, i bɛ se ka Mecropolis baara.
guide.why.title: Mun na i bɛ a baara
guide.why.1: I bɛ se ka suman minnu dɔnna sisan, minnu bɛ yiriwa ani minnu bɛ surun ka sɔrɔ ye joona.
guide.why.2: I mako tɛ ka foro bɛɛ kunnafoni falen i yɛrɛ ye. Ni waati sera, app bɛ suman bɛɛ taa ɲɛ fɔlɔ-fɔlɔ.
guide.why.3: A bɛ i lasɔmi nɛnɛ ani kalaya kan tile nataw la, ani kɔnɔmɔgɔ minnu yera i ka foroba dafɛ.
guide.why.4: Nin fɛnw bɛɛ bɛ mara yɔrɔ kelen na ni u don ye: furakɛli, kɔnɔmɔgɔ min i yera walima hakilina. I bɛ se ka u lajɛ kɔfɛ.
guide.why.5: Hakɛ bɛɛ bɔyɔrɔ bɛ jira, walasa i ka dɔn min na i bɛ se ka la.
guide.heat.title: App bɛ suman yiriwali dɔn cogo min na
guide.heat.p1: Ni kalaya ka ca, sumanw bɛ yiriwa teliya la; ni suma don, u bɛ yiriwa dɔɔni. Mecropolis bɛ o kalaya jate don o don, ka a wele kalaya hakɛ, dɔnnikɛlaw bɛ min wele GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Don o don, a bɛ funteni ni sumaya cɛmancɛ ta, ka suman yiriwali jɔyɔrɔ funteni bɔ a la. Min tora, o ye o don kalaya hakɛ ye. Suma don tɛ foyi fara a kan.
guide.heat.p3: Suman bɛɛ mako bɛ kalaya hakɛ dafalen dɔ la sani a ka sɔrɔ. Ka bɔ dɔnni ma, ni kalaya hakɛ bɛ surunya o hakɛ la, suman bɛ taa yiriwali yɔrɔ nata la.
guide.heat.p4: Funteni hakɛw bɛ bɔ Open-Meteo la. O ye waati kunnafoni diɲɛ bɛɛ la, jɔnjɔnni tɛ.
guide.stages.title: Yiriwali yɔrɔ wɔɔrɔ
guide.stages.intro: Suman bɛɛ bɛ nin yiriwali yɔrɔw bɛɛ tɛmɛ, nin cogo in na.
guide.stages.planning: Sanni waati labɛnna, nka suman ma dɔn fɔlɔ.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Suman ye a mako kalaya fanba sɔrɔ. Sɔrɔli labɛn waati sera.
guide.stages.harvested: Suman ye a mako kalaya bɛɛ sɔrɔ, o la a ka kan ka sɔrɔ. I dɔrɔn de bɛ se ka a fɔ ko a sɔrɔla tiɲɛ na. O la app bɛ a wele kalaya la mɔgɔya.
guide.stages.review: Sanni waati banna; i bɛ se ka a kɛcogo lajɛ kɔfɛ.
guide.stages.p2: App bɛ suman bɛɛ lajɛ su o su, ani ni mɔgɔ ye lajɛli walima furakɛli fara a kan. I fana bɛ se ka Reconcile now digi sanni waati kan walasa ka a lajɛ o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ.
guide.start.title: Daminɛli
guide.start.1: Ɲɛ fɔlɔ dayɛlɛ. I bɛ se ka waati karti, dugukolo, kɔnɔmɔgɔw ani suman bɔli ye misali foroba la, hali ni i ma don.
guide.start.2: Sign in digi sanfɛ, ka misali jatebɔsɛbɛn kunnafoni min dira i ma baara.
guide.start.3: Foroba dɔ sugandi. O bɛ o foroba kunnafoni ɲɛ dayɛlɛ.
guide.start.4: Sanni waati dɔ digi walasa ka o foro kelen ni o suman kelen kunnafoni bɛɛ ye.
guide.start.5: Kan sugandili yɔrɔ baara ɲɛ bɛɛ sanfɛ walasa ka kan falen. App bɛ i ka sugandili hakili to.
guide.home.title: Ɲɛ fɔlɔ
guide.home.p1: Ɲɛ fɔlɔ bɛ mara karti jira, a ɲɛ bɛ falen ka bɛn dugukolo ye kalaya hakɛ min sɔrɔ nin sanni waati la. A fana bɛ bi waati, tile nataw waati, misali foroba dugukolo, kɔnɔmɔgɔ minnu yera a dafɛ sisan, ani mara suman bɔli cɛmancɛ jira. I mako tɛ ka don walasa ka a ye.
guide.dashboard.title: Foroba kunnafoni ɲɛ
guide.dashboard.intro: Kunnafoni ɲɛ bɛ foroba kelen jira. Nin ye a yɔrɔw ye, ka bɔ sanfɛ ka taa duguma. Foroba sugandili yɔrɔ sanfɛ bɛ i to ka taa foroba wɛrɛ la.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Foroba kunnafoni surun
guide.dashboard.summary: Foroba forow ni a ha hakɛ, sanni waati minnu bɛ taa ɲɛ, ani suman minnu labɛnna ka sɔrɔ.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Min mako bɛ lajɛli la
guide.dashboard.alerts: Lasɔmi surunw, i n'a fɔ nɛnɛ walima kalaya nata, suman min labɛnna, sanni waati min ma daminɛ a waati la, walima kɔnɔmɔgɔ minnu yera foro dafɛ. Lasɔmi bɛɛ bɛ a sababu fɔ.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Foroba cogoya
guide.dashboard.conditions: Bi waati, waati nata, dugukolo ani kɔnɔmɔgɔ minnu bɛ foroba in dafɛ.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Sanni waati yiriwali
guide.dashboard.progress: Suman bɛɛ ka karti bɛ a sɔrɔ kalaya hakɛ jira. I bɛ se ka forow suma ɲɔgɔn na, ka lisiti lajigin i n'a fɔ jatebɔ gafe (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Forow
guide.dashboard.fields: Foroba foro bɛɛ, u bonya, u dugukolo ani u sumanw.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Sɛbɛnw ɲini
guide.dashboard.search: I bɛ min ɲini, o sɛbɛn kumakan nɔgɔman na, i n'a fɔ nɛgɛnw tirikaba la. A bɛ lajɛliw ni furakɛliw sɔrɔ minnu kɔrɔ ye kelen ye, hali ni u kumakanw tɛ kelen ye.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Ladilikanw
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Baara min ka kan ka kɛ foro la, i n'a fɔ furakɛli walima nɔgɔ. I bɛ se ka o bɛɛ sɔn walima ka a ban, ka a taamasiyɛn ko a kɛra ni baara banna.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Baara laban
guide.dashboard.activity: Suman bɛɛ ye yiriwali yɔrɔ kura sɔrɔ waati lisiti.
guide.season.title: Sanni waati ɲɛ
guide.season.intro: Sanni waati ye suman kelen ye foro kelen na san kelen kɔnɔ. A kunnafoni bɛɛ bɛ a ka ɲɛ na.
guide.season.top.label: Ɲɛ sanfɛ
guide.season.top: Suman, foro, dɔnni don, sɔrɔli don jateminɛnen ani suman bɔli ni i ye a don.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Yiriwali yɔrɔw
guide.season.pipeline: Yiriwali yɔrɔ wɔɔrɔ, ni sisan ta taamasiyɛnnen ye. Reconcile now digi walasa ka a lajɛ o yɔrɔnin bɛɛ ni suman ka kan ka taa ɲɛ.
guide.season.readiness.label: Tigɛli labɛnni
guide.season.readiness: App mako bɛ minnu na sani a ka suman taa ɲɛ, olu lajɛli lisiti, i n'a fɔ dɔnni don ani waati kunnafoni caman. Fɛn bɛɛ bɛ Pass, Warning walima Blocked jira. Ni a datugulen don, a bɛ min tununna fɔ.
guide.season.evidence.label: Dalilu
guide.season.evidence: App ye sɛbɛn minnu baara ka tigɛli kɛ, walasa i ka se ka u lajɛ.
guide.season.propose.label: Ladilikan dɔ di
guide.season.propose: Baara dɔ jira foro in kama, ni sanni waati daliluw ye. A bɛ to sɛbɛn fɔlɔ ye fo mɔgɔ dɔ ka sɔn a ma kunnafoni ɲɛ kan.
guide.season.gdd.label: Yiriwali kalaya hakɛ
guide.season.gdd: Ja bɛ kalaya hakɛ farali ɲɔgɔn kan jira ka bɔ dɔnni ma, ni suman mako hakɛ dafalen ye.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Ni a kɛra ten?
guide.season.whatIf: Dɔnni don kuntaala walima kɔfɛ, walima sanni waati kalayalen walima sumayalen lajɛ, ka a ye kalaya hakɛ bɛ falen cogo min na. Foyi tɛ mara.
guide.season.summary.label: Sanni waati kunnafoni surun
guide.season.summary: AI bɛ sanni waati sɛbɛnw kunnafoni surun sɛbɛn. A kalan i n'a fɔ dɛmɛbaga, ka sɛbɛnw lajɛ ni fɛn dɔ man di.
guide.season.notes.label: Sanni waati hakilinaw
guide.season.notes: Sanni waati hakilinaw ni u don ye. I bɛ se ka u fara, ka u falen, ka u bɔ, ani ka hakilina kɔrɔ dɔ lasegin.
guide.season.files.label: Foro ja ani dugukolo lajɛli lapɔri
guide.season.files: Foro ja ni labo dugukolo lajɛli PDF don.
guide.season.log.label: Foro sɛbɛn gafe
guide.season.log: I ye min ye foro la (lajɛliw), ani i ye min kɛ a la (furakɛliw, i n'a fɔ furakɛli ni a fura tɔgɔ ni a hakɛ ye).
guide.season.history.label: Falenniw tariku
guide.season.history: Falenni bɛɛ min marala nin sanni waati la, ni a don ye.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Mara hakɛ suma
guide.season.benchmark: Mara suman bɔli cɛmancɛ, min bɔra foroba kunnafoniw na. A ye sumaɲɔgɔnya de ye; a tɛ i ka foro suman bɔli ye.
guide.season.pests.label: Mara kɔnɔmɔgɔw
guide.season.pests: Kɔnɔmɔgɔ minnu yera foro dafɛ, u sɛbɛnna GBIF la, min ye bɛɛ ta lajɛli kunnafoni marayɔrɔ ye. Fetch sightings digi walasa ka kura sɔrɔ.
guide.sources.title: Hakɛw bɛ bɔ yɔrɔ min
guide.sources.weather: Bi waati, waati nata ani tile tɛmɛnenw waati bɛ bɔ Open-Meteo la.
guide.sources.soil: Dugukolo kunnafoni bɛ bɔ SoilGrids la, min ye diɲɛ dugukolo karti ye.
guide.sources.pests: Kɔnɔmɔgɔ lajɛliw bɛ bɔ GBIF la, min ye bɛɛ ta lajɛli kunnafoni marayɔrɔ ye.
guide.sources.yields: Mara suman bɔliw bɛ bɔ USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa ani World Bank la.
guide.sources.you: Tɔ bɛɛ, i n'a fɔ hakilinaw, furakɛliw ani i yɛrɛ ka suman bɔliw, ye i walima i ka jɛkulu ye min sɛbɛn.
guide.limits.title: A tɛ se ka min kɛ
guide.limits.model: An yɛrɛ ye suman bɛɛ mako kalaya hakɛ jateminɛ. U ma lajɛ foro la fɔlɔ. U baara i n'a fɔ ladilikan, ka la i yɛrɛ ye min ye i ka foro la.
guide.limits.maturity: Sumaya hakɛ bɛ jira ko suman ka kan ka sɔrɔ. I dɔrɔn de bɛ a dɔn ni a sɔrɔla tiɲɛ na.
guide.limits.translation: AI de ye bamanankan bamanankanw sɛbɛn. U ka kan ka nɔgɔya ka kalan, nka bamanankan fɔla ma kan bɛɛ lajɛ.
guide.limits.demo: Demo bɛ da wuli bɛɛ ye, o la kana gundo fɛn si sɛbɛn a kɔnɔ.
